title.narrative: Advancing Governance and Resilience Priorities at the Arab Water Forum

description.narrative: This activity will facilitate and coordinate a regional dialogue on the Arab region’s priority water security themes, emphasizing practical governance reforms, investable solutions, and measurable climate‑resilient actions. This activity will convene and lead the session on “Paths to Inclusive Water Governance,” drawing on UNESCO Cairo/HYD’s technical expertise in inclusive, gender‑responsive governance, groundwater management, and climate resilience. This activity will also strengthen regional technical capacity by contributing expertise on digital innovation for WEFE systems, nature‑based solutions, and climate‑risk management, enhancing knowledge sharing across Arab countries.
